messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — opened a docs PR that covers the split-HSM + offline DNS flow for Private installs. Needs SME review for the KMS bits.

Priya Kumar: Link?

Alex Chen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (WIP) — main changes: new preflight for air-gapped DNS seed, step to register HSM PKCS#11 slot before bootstrap, and a migration subsection for 1.x -> 2.x connector changes.

Mateo Rivera: I skimmed the KMS section. Two quick asks: call out that some HSMs require user-space driver load before pkcs11-tool runs, and add the systemd example for ordering.

Alex Chen: Good point. I added a short systemd drop-in snippet for ordering:

```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.service.d/10-hsm-order.conf
[Unit]
After=p11-kit.service
Wants=p11-kit.service
```

Jen O'Neal: Also include the optional env var for the installer CLI when offline: `REDWOOD_INSTALL_DNS_SEED=./seeds.yaml` — saved me debugging yesterday.

Alex Chen: Adding it. Should we add a tiny sample seeds.yaml format?

Priya Kumar: Yes, minimal example please. People keep pasting long configs. Two lines is better.

Alex Chen: Added this YAML sample to the PR: 

```
# seeds.yaml
- host: 10.0.10.5
  names:
    - api.internal.redwood
- host: 10.0.10.6
  names: [kv.internal.redwood]
```

Mateo Rivera: For the HSM migration notes: clarify that the slot label may be different and we recommend `pkcs11-tool --list-slots` preflight. Also mention that the HSM plugin path could change between onprem bundles.

Alex Chen: Done. I also added an SDK snippet for the connector to show explicit module path override during upgrade: 

```
# python example
from redwood_sdk import PrivateConnector
c = PrivateConnector(hsm_pkcs11_lib="/opt/hsm/lib/libhsm.so", slot_label="redwood-slot")
```

Jen O'Neal: Small nit: the networking matrix references port 8443 but our installer checks 9443 in some airgap manifests. Can we add a note about both ports and where each is used?

Alex Chen: Good catch — I added a short table and cross-links. Also fixed the manifest reference.

deploy-bot: CI check: docs lint failed on file docs/private/install/migration.md — line 78: long line > 120 chars.

Alex Chen: On it, will wrap and push.

Priya Kumar: Can someone from security glance at the HSM example wording? We should avoid implying we recommend shipping PKCS#11 libs inside the airgap bundle unless approved.

Mateo Rivera: I'll ping sec. @security please review the HSM shipping note in that PR when you have a sec.

docs-bot: Marked PR 4123 as requested-reviewers: Mateo Rivera, Priya Kumar.

Jen O'Neal: Reviewer checklist suggestion (post in PR description):
- verify systemd ordering snippet covers Red Hat/CentOS and Debian (package names differ)
- ensure seeds.yaml parsing example actually matches installer validation
- confirm HSM PKCS#11 path wording doesn't imply we package third-party libs

Alex Chen: Thanks — I added the checklist to the PR body. Anything else before I push the lint fix?

Priya Kumar: Add a tiny troubleshooting note: common error `PKCS11: no slots found` — suggestion to run `sudo modprobe hsm_driver` and re-run `pkcs11-tool --list-slots`. Keeps tickets down.

Alex Chen: Added. Pushing now.

Mateo Rivera: Thx — once CI passes I'll merge and backport to the 2.0.x docs branch.

Alex Chen: Perfect. Will open a short follow-up PR next week to add an ops-runbook snippet for post-migration key verification.

Jen O'Neal: :thumbsup:

Matt (off-thread): FYI — left a comment on the PR suggesting we add an automated sample for generating seeds.yaml from the installer (one-liner). Could reduce copy-paste.
